name: square-fee-dashboard
description: Local-first Square business dashboard (root dev orchestrator)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: npm --prefix frontend run build && SERVE_STATIC=true npm --prefix backend start
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
